| description = Kinlo Strongarm's Jade Reaver turn-in quest (Druid and Ranger epics) works at apprehensive or better faction. His hails still require indifferent.

'''WARNING: Some parts of the Ranger Epic Quest may require higher than apprehensive.  Kinlo ate a Ranger's [[Hammer of the Ancients]] turn-in, with apprehensive con, on 23 June 2017.'''

-You can sneak behind Kinlo Strongarm to turn in the Hammer of the Ancients safely.  He only needs indifferent faction or better. If you want to farm faction, 30 belts and 8 shoulderpads from Crushbone took my ranger from apprehensive to amiable. ****11/13/24 was apprehensive without sneak, but sneaking to get him Indiff then turning in was successful and yielded the ore / spawned Usbak --- be careful not to hail him and turn him around before you turn in if doing this method***

-Although I got the message "Kinlo Strongarm will not speak to you" from hails, I turned in Jade Reaver at apprehensive 5/19/20 and he still gave the enchanted clay.

-Druid (lvl 47) Apprehensive. Got the message "Kinlo Strongarm will not speak to you", I turned in Jade Reaver and he gave me the enchanted clay 9/11/22.
